text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Library brings together every game in your Batocera collection into a single view. Instead of browsing individual systems, it allows you to explore your entire game library from one place. Games remain organized by their original platform while providing a convenient way to search, sort, and access titles across all supported systems.
